ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer, found 1.26.4
root_cause: The Windows NPU models-test environment has an installed pyarrow build that requires NumPy >= 2.0, while the environment's NumPy package remains pinned/resolved to 1.26.4. Loading the bert-base-uncased model via HuggingFace `datasets` transitively imports pyarrow, which raises ImportError at import time before any OpenVINO conversion/inference code runs. This is a pre-existing dependency/environment pinning issue in the Windows NPU test job (unrelated to the merge-queue PR itself, which only touches a benchmarks CSV doc file), and has recurred identically across 10 separate merge-queue runs since 2026-11-05.
reproduction_steps: On the Windows NPU test environment (Python 3.11.9), run: pip show numpy pyarrow; then python -c "from datasets import load_dataset" — this reproduces the ImportError directly. Alternatively run the single test: pytest install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/test_hf_transformers.py::TestTransformersModel::test_convert_model_precommit[NPU-bert-base-uncased-bert] with the same environment's installed numpy/pyarrow versions.
recommended_actions: Pin numpy>=2.0 (or a pyarrow wheel built against NumPy 1.x, e.g. pyarrow<16 or explicit ABI-compatible pin) in the Windows NPU test requirements used by install/tests/model_hub_tests
Audit the requirements/constraints files feeding the Windows NPU precommit job for a numpy<2 pin that conflicts with the installed pyarrow/datasets versions
Add a CI smoke check that imports `datasets` right after environment setup to fail fast with a clearer dependency error before running the full model-hub test suite
Consider re-running the workflow_rerunner only after the dependency pin is fixed; a plain rerun will not clear this deterministic failure
prevention_strategies: Add numpy/pyarrow version constraints to the Windows NPU test requirements file(s) and verify them in a lightweight pre-flight job. When bumping either package, run a quick `pip check` / import smoke test in CI before merging dependency updates that affect install/tests/model_hub_tests.
historical_context: This exact signature has now been observed 10 times since 2026-11-05 (see pattern 90d42369fa7c1efb.json), across multiple unrelated merge-queue PRs, confirming it is an environment-level dependency pinning issue rather than anything introduced by individual PRs (including the current PR #39512, which only changes a benchmarks CSV).
